item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Functions Network Troubleshooter v2
item.description:
Azure Functions Network Troubleshooter v2 is now in public preview. It provides a top-down view of Function App dependencies across Storage, Service Bus, and Azure Files, with inspection details for supported dependencies.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Network Watcher – Connection analyzer
item.description:
Azure Network Watcher’s Connection analyzer for ExpressRoute Circuit is in public preview. It helps pinpoint where packet loss occurs between Azure and on-premises by providing faster, evidence-based troubleshooting.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: k8s: Why Is My Kubernetes Job Still Pending? Tracing Kueue Admission with Headlamp
item.description:
The article introduces the Headlamp Kueue plugin, which helps trace why a Kubernetes Job is still suspended by checking Kueue admission state before looking at Pod scheduling. It walks through a Headlamp-based workflow for inspecting Workloads, LocalQueues, ClusterQueues, ResourceFlavors, and Cohorts, and notes that the 0.1.0-alpha release is read-only.

  • Source: Kubernetes Official Blog

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: New and improved troubleshooting guides for Azure Database for PostgreSQL
item.description:
Updated troubleshooting guidance is now available for Azure Database for PostgreSQL flexible server. The documentation adds expanded diagnostics for high CPU, memory, IOPS, temporary file usage, and autovacuum issues to help identify root causes.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Copilot Troubleshooting Agent
item.description:
Azure Copilot Troubleshooting Agent is now generally available. It provides a built-in Azure Copilot capability for investigating and resolving operational issues, and is available through Azure Copilot and Support.

  • Source: Azure Updates
